verdict.rationale: Langfuse documents capturing traces through native Python/JS SDKs, "100+ library/framework integrations," OpenTelemetry (an OTLP endpoint), and LLM gateways such as LiteLLM. A community user also praises its integration and developer experience. One user reported implementation struggles, but that is general friction, not a concrete failure of the integrations. Missing for 10: explicit evidence naming LangChain, the OpenAI SDK, or the Vercel AI SDK integrations; integration-specific setup docs; and independent hands-on corroboration of those specific integrations.
